text:
Mia Chen: Heads up — saw a spike in unassigned leads in HubSpot this morning; lots of low-enrichment records skipping RR. Anyone else?
Akash Patel: saw that too, ~200 leads in last 2h, enrichmentScore <= 0.2 getting filtered by our 'enrich>=0.5' rule and then not landing in fallback queue.
Jules (revops): that's the `claimable` workflow we added. If enrichment is low we were intentionally holding to avoid bad assignments. But we didn't wire the fallback to ops-inbound; bug.
Mia Chen: ok can we change fallback to assign to 'overflow-sales' after 10m? We need <5m SLA though for MQLs. :thinking_face: 
Leo Rivera: 10m is too long. Proposal: keep 2m for routing attempts, then if still unclaimed, route to 'ops-inbound' and create hs property `routing_reason=low_enrich`.
Akash Patel: +1 for ops-inbound. Also suggest adding a quick scoreboard in BigQuery to catch these; SQL:
```sql
SELECT count(*) as cnt, routing_reason
FROM marketing.leads
WHERE _ingest_day >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY)
  AND owner IS NULL
GROUP BY routing_reason;
```
Jules (revops): I can patch the HubSpot workflow today: change the 'Claim fallback' action to call the webhook instead of pausing. Will also add a property update.
crm-bot: HubSpot webhook test passed (200 OK) — payload sample: {leadId: 82341, enrichmentScore: 0.12} 
Mia Chen: great. Can we also tweak round-robin to skip leads with 'manual_hold' tag but still include low enrichment ones after fallback? We want to prevent stuck holds.
Leo Rivera: yes. Implementation note: in rr-service add `exclude_tags` param. I can open a PR with tests.
Akash Patel: can someone estimate impact on SLA numbers if we lower initial hold to 2m? rough calc: current avg claim time = 4.2m for un-enriched leads; pushing fallback earlier should reduce unassigned count by ~70%.
Jules (revops): i'll run a simulation in HS for the last 7 days after patch to confirm.
Mia Chen: timeline — patch HubSpot workflow today, rr-service PR tomorrow, monitor for 24h, then revert if any regressions. Anyone object?
Leo Rivera: no objections, will post PR link when ready.
Akash Patel: prepping a dashboard widget in console to show 'fallback->ops-inbound' counts and SLA breaches.
Mia Chen: thanks team. tagging @oncall in case we see a surge: @oncall :eyes: 
Jules (revops): FYI will add note to handoff playbook, and update the ticket 1234 to reflect the new flow.
crm-bot: Ticket 1234 updated: 'fallback-to-ops-inbound for low-enrichment leads' assigned to Jules.
Mia Chen: closing loop — let's regroup tomorrow 9:30am if any anomalies.
